artworks.title: Wind-Blown Trees
artworks.dimensions:
block: 226 x 301 mm
sheet: 299 x 380 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with windblown trees, a low horizon, rolling hills, and a monochrome color palette. The style resembles block printing with bold black lines on a light background. The brushstrokes create textured hills and sky. The trees have a dynamic silhouette.

artworks.title: Lodgings for Gents
artworks.dimensions:
image: 305 x 229 mm
sheet 394 x 254 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image depicts a city street scene with a tall building under construction. The perspective is looking up towards the building, showing intricate framework and detailed line work characteristic of an etching. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of brown and black. Smaller buildings line the street, leading the eye towards the towering construction. Scumbled lines in the sky suggest smoke or cloud forms.

artworks.title: Washington Arch
artworks.dimensions:
Image: 254 x 168 mm
Sheet: 330 x 244 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows the Washington Square Arch near the top third, a street below with people and horse-drawn carriages, a body of water with lily pads, and reflections of the arch. Trees on either side blend into the buildings in the distance. The artwork is in monochrome using black and gray tones.

artworks.title: Masonry Versus Sky
artworks.dimensions:
block: 179 x 128 mm
sheet: 267 x 199 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a wall extending into the distance under a dramatic sky with swirling clouds. A pile of rocks in the foreground obscures the horizon. The style is detailed and monochromatic, with precise strokes depicting the brick wall and rocks. The color palette is limited to black and white, creating a contrast that emphasizes textures and light.

artworks.title: Untitled (Kingston Church)
artworks.dimensions:
image: 351 x 405 mm
sheet: 446 x 583 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image depicts a church with a prominent entrance featuring large doors framed by columns and architectural detailing above. In the background, barren trees with slender trunks are seen against a light sky. The sketch is detailed, using fine lines to show depth and texture. The color scheme is monochromatic, using shades of gray and black. Paving stones lead towards the main entrance, with small headstones in the grass to the left. In the distance, a smaller building with a bell tower is partially visible through the trees.

artworks.title: Ashokan Reservoir
artworks.dimensions:
image: 213 x 293 mm
sheet: 344 x 482 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape from an elevated viewpoint. A balustrade and tiled floor are in the foreground. A figure leans on the railing, overlooking a body of water that leads into rolling hills and mountains. The horizon is high, suggesting a vast view. The hills and water are created with dense, textured brushstrokes. The color palette is shades of grey and black. The scene has a tranquil yet somber atmosphere. The limited palette emphasizes contrasts in texture and form, and light and shadow.

artworks.title: East Side Junk Shop
artworks.dimensions:
image: 178 x 171 mm
paper: 318 x 238 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed etching of a city street, focusing on a group of buildings. On the right, a narrow brick building with windows and a doorway is depicted. In the center, there is an open doorway labeled "RAGS" with a figure standing in it. To the left, clotheslines with laundry are strung across an alleyway. The scene is rendered in a grayscale color palette with intricate linework, showcasing textures and shadows.

artworks.title: Bridge
artworks.dimensions:
block: 254 x 203 mm
sheet: 310 x 259 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape viewed through an arched structure. The scene is depicted in a printmaking style, potentially using a linocut or woodcut technique. The horizon is in the center of the arch, featuring tall rock formations that reach into the sky. The marks are bold and expressive, highlighting the texture of the rocks and clouds. The color scheme is monochromatic, mainly black and white, emphasizing contrast. Close to us, there is an arch outline with a hat-like object in the lower right corner. In the distance, light and shadow on the rocks and clouds add to the dramatic effect.

artworks.title: Untitled (Bridge with Sailor and Woman)
artworks.dimensions:
block: 255 x 203 mm
sheet: 385 x 305 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a surreal, fantastical scene with abstract elements. There are two figures sitting closely together under an archway, which frames a surreal landscape in the background. The scene is filled with swirling forms resembling clouds or puffs of smoke, floating around the figures and in the background. Behind them, there are towering rock formations or abstract monolith-like structures. To the right, a small boat with a person is navigating a narrow waterway. The use of contrasting light and shadow gives the scene a dramatic and mysterious atmosphere.

artworks.title: The Times Building
artworks.dimensions:
image: 301 x 214 mm
sheet: 394 x 279 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image displays a cityscape with a prominent tall building in the center. The scene features various buildings and streets converging towards the central structure. The artwork is created using an etching technique, giving it a detailed and textured appearance. The depiction is in monochrome, with varying shades of black and grey creating depth and contrast. Buildings line the streets on the left and right, and there are indistinct forms indicating urban activity in the foreground.

artworks.title: New York From Ellis Island
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image depicts a cityscape viewed from a distance over a body of water. The horizon features a skyline of skyscrapers and high-rise buildings. The city buildings are positioned just above the horizon. The brushstrokes are loose and sketch-like, giving an impressionistic feel, especially in the clouds. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of black, white, and grey. Boats and ships are scattered across the water. The detailed architecture of the city sits beyond this activity, partially shrouded by atmospheric haze. Large cloud formations dominate the sky in the background.

artworks.title: On the Beach
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image depicts a beach scene with people lounging on the sand. The horizon is visible at the top, where the sea meets the sky. The etching technique showcases expressive lines capturing the figures. The color palette is primarily black and white, contrasting the groups of people scattered throughout. Closest to the viewer, individuals are seated on the sand, conversing or relaxing. Beyond them, more people form clusters extending towards the horizon.

artworks.title: The Flat Iron New York
artworks.dimensions:
Image: 337 x 254 mm
Sheet: 381 x 267 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a large vertical structure at the center, slightly to the right. The horizon is low, marked by the base of the structure and vague shapes that could be small buildings and trees. The brushstrokes are soft, creating a muted atmosphere. The color palette is primarily grayscale, emphasizing light and shadow. The ground is in shadows with silhouettes of people, adding depth. The background has blurred outlines, enhancing the tranquil nature of the scene.

artworks.title: Temple Bar
artworks.medium: etching with drypoint on Japanese paper
artworks.dimensions:
image: 305 x 203 mm
sheet:  368 x 257 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a bustling urban street with buildings adorned with advertisements and signage. A tower of a larger building is visible against the skyline. The style of the image is an etching with fine, detailed lines creating a textured appearance. The scene includes a large pedestal with a winged figure, people in motion, and a monochromatic color palette of black, white, and gray. Light and shadow are used to enhance depth, and there are reflective surfaces suggesting wet conditions.

artworks.title: Street Scene (New York)
artworks.dimensions:
image: 406 x 292 mm
paper: 495 x 387 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a tenement building with children playing outside. The scene features several children gathered on the front stoop of a brick building in an urban setting. The architecture includes a prominent arched doorway with detailed stonework, flanked by windows with shutters. A narrow pathway leads towards the building, with cobbled streets in the foreground. There is a stroller or pushcart near the sidewalk, and various figures are visible in the windows. The drawing reflects the early 20th-century urban life often captured by artists who focused on American cityscapes and their inhabitants.

artworks.title: Untitled (Lineman)
artworks.dimensions:
block: 193 x 138 mm
sheet: 229 x 203 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: This is an image of a worker using a saw. The drawing depicts a person sawing through a piece of wood on a framework of beams. The artist uses strong lines and contrasts of black and beige to emphasize the texture and material of the wood. The style is reminiscent of early 20th-century woodcuts, highlighting manual labor and printmaking craftsmanship.

artworks.title: Home, Sweet Home
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image features a low vantage point looking slightly upwards towards trees and houses, with the horizon out of view. The artwork is done in an etching style with detailed line work forming textures of leaves, rooftops, and grass. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of brown and beige. A path leads towards cottages nestled among tall trees.

artworks.title: Fresh Eggs
artworks.dimensions:
image: 318 x 229 mm
sheet:  457 x 375 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals in an outdoor rural setting. The person in the foreground is a young girl standing on the edge of a wooden platform, reaching upward with both arms extended. Her back-facing features include long hair tied with a ribbon, dressed in a knee-length dress, long sleeves, stockings, and shoes. The platform is placed above a wooden and metal wheel. The second person is a man mostly obscured by surrounding hay, leaning from the upper level, handing a basket of eggs to the girl below. The man wears a broad-brimmed hat and appears in simple work attire. The background is a barn with hay stacked around them, tools, farming implements, ropes, and wooden boards are seen amidst the hay.

artworks.title: Woolworth Building June Night
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a street-level view looking up at the Woolworth Building, which is the focal point of the composition. The scene is set at night, with a simplified and stylized depiction of the building against a deep blue sky. The color palette consists of blues, greens, purples, and yellows for lit windows and streetlights. Other elements include cars, streetlights, silhouettes of trees, and architectural features in the background.

artworks.title: Grant's Tomb
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image depicts Grant's Tomb in an impressionistic style. The tomb is shown in the upper right center, using bold brushstrokes and flat colors. The architectural form is portrayed with simple shapes and contrasting colors of blue and yellow against a green-blue background. The perspective elevates the scene, showing the tomb and trees extending upwards. In the lower part of the image, people are engaged in leisure activities, with small, abstract figures. The color palette consists of green, blue, yellow, and earthy tones, creating a harmonious atmosphere.

artworks.title: Brooklyn Bridge Late Afternoon
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a cityscape with a suspension bridge, likely the Brooklyn Bridge, in the background. The skyline features abstract geometric building outlines against a yellow sky. The foreground shows water with vibrant orange and yellow strokes, resembling sunlight reflections. A decorative pattern in deep blue is at the bottom. The artwork features a limited color palette of muted blues, soft yellows, and a creamy base.

artworks.title: Untitled (Experiment—Wet Aquatint)
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with rocky terrain leading to a distant body of water. A sailboat can be seen on the water, where the horizon is implied by the separation between land and sky. The brushstrokes are textured and soft, creating a hazy effect and emphasizing light and shadow over detail. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of gray and black to convey a moody atmosphere. Rocky textures and silhouettes of trees are visible in the foreground, with tree shapes ascending into the dark sky with soft cloud formations.

artworks.title: The Titian - Minneapolis
artworks.dimensions:
image: 230 x 346 mm
sheet: 287 x 410 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures gathered around a central image. The figures are depicted in various poses, some gesturing or in conversation, while others are in contemplative or reverent postures. The central image resembles a religious or spiritual figure surrounded by a halo. The room has a sense of depth and perspective, and the figures are arranged in a semi-circular formation, focused towards the central image. The use of shading and line work adds texture and dimension to the scene, creating a sense of movement and interaction among the figures.

artworks.title: A City Farm—New York
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
